pairs.evidence: apps/console/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json:10 The console's Vite output is packed into a local Tauri desktop bundle, and its CSP only allows connections to a 127.0.0.1:7717 daemon, so no hosting platform builds or serves it; ripgrep (case-insensitive) over apps/console found no vercel, netlify, wrangler or cache-control, so the subject's precondition (deploying through a hosting platform) does not hold.

techniques.evidence: apps/console/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json:9 The build runs locally inside `tauri build` from the project's own script. No hosted builder exists to drift from it.
apps/console/vite.config.ts:10 Vite emits hashed assets, but they ship inside the desktop bundle. No HTTP host sends cache directives for them.
apps/console/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json:25 There is no public demonstration deployment. The app only talks to a localhost daemon.
